messages:
Maria (CS): Heads-up on Valence pilot — quick health check. We saw a brief spike in errors for eu-west-1 last night and a few KMS timeouts. Pulling metrics now, but want to align on immediate mitigations and customer comms.
Aj (DevOps): I’m looking — noticed a flurry of reconnects to the HSM cluster around 02:14 UTC. KV cache fallback kicked in and generated higher QPS to the fallback path. Error sig: `KMS_TIMEOUT` and `HSM_CONN_RESET`.
Liam (Onboard): Onboarding checklist shows Valence rotated keys last week; the IAM principal in our eu-west-1 KMS config still references the old role. That would explain the handshakes failing.
Jess (Valence): Yep, we rotated keys on Wed evening. We didn’t realize the principal needed updating on your side — saw end-to-end latency jump ~120ms and a handful of 5xx. Sorry about the coordination gap.
SRE Bot: Incident created: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4521|INC-4521> — label: customer-impact, priority: P2. Assigned: Aj, Maria.
Maria (CS): Ok — proposed immediate plan: 1) Aj apply temporary routing to us-east-1 pool for incoming inference from Valence regions, 2) Liam & Valence to confirm KMS principal update, 3) hold any further key rotations until stable, 4) collect cost/latency delta for renewals team. Any objections?
Aj (DevOps): No objections. I can push a canary route to us-east-1 and enable aggressive prefix caching for Valence service-id. Doing a quick pre-check:
```
# verify kms connectivity
curl -sS https://kv-proxy.eu-west-1.redwood/api/ping || echo "fail"
```
Aj (DevOps): Starting canary push now — will monitor error rate and latency on the route. I’ll post status in 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam (Renewals): FYI — Valence is in conversation about renewal in 6 weeks. If latency stays elevated or there’s repeated KMS instability we should expect pricing/credit asks. Please capture time windows and affected tokens.
Jess (Valence): We’ll pause any further key rotations and let Liam confirm the principal update. Can you also share the HSM rotation/runbook? That would help us keep in sync.
Liam (Onboard): I’ll update the KMS principal today and DM the ARN once done. Also adding a short runbook snippet to the shared drive for Valence teams.
SRE Bot: deploy-bot: canary route pushed to us-east-1 (cid: d4f3). Monitoring hooks active.
Aj (DevOps): Canary status: in-progress. Current error rate on original eu-west-1 path: 3.9% -> after canary 0.7% on routed traffic (15m window). Latency for routed requests ~48ms median.
Maria (CS): Great — that’s within our SLO band. Action items: Aj — keep canary + follow 1hr. Liam — confirm IAM principal update and paste ARN here. Jess — hold rotations for 48hrs. Maria — I’ll prepare a short customer-facing summary and send to Valence and the renewals team.
Sam (Renewals): Please include an estimate of token spend delta for routed traffic and note any credits we may owe if SLA breached.
Aj (DevOps): Will add a short thread with metrics (p50/p95, token counts) to the incident.
Liam (Onboard): Principal updated, ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/valence-redwood-kms-access. Jess, please confirm on your side.
Jess (Valence): Confirmed — principal matches. Re-enabling key rotation on our side will wait for your final ok.
Maria (CS): OK — tentative next check-in tomorrow 09:00 UTC. I’ll close the immediate ticket if metrics hold for 3h. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Aj (DevOps): Quick note — I’ll schedule an automated smoke every 5m for the next 24h to catch regressions.
SRE Bot: INC-4521 — status updated to monitoring. Next update scheduled in 60m.
